name: SSH Tunnel Device Forwarding Disabled
description:
Ensures sshd does not permit tun device forwarding (PermitTunnel not enabled). The OpenSSH default is no.
Privilege: reads /etc/ssh/sshd_config and its drop-in directory. Debian and Ubuntu ship these files world-readable; RHEL-family systems ship sshd_config as mode 0600, so the agent needs read access to it there (an unreadable file fails the check instead of passing). On Linux the rule passes with LEA_RULE_no_service when no sshd process is running.

validation.command: if cat /proc/*/comm 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^sshd$'; then cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf 2>/dev/null; else echo 'LEA_RULE_no_service'; fi
